"''Who are you?'"
"The mayor of this town.''|Shep and CX-2|{{TBB|Point of No Return (The Bad Batch)}}}} '''Shep Hazard''' was a [[human]] who was the [[mayor]] of the [[Pabu island|remote island]] on [[Pabu]]. He lived there along with his daughter, [[Lyana Hazard]]. ==Personality and traits== Shep Hazard was a friendly and welcoming man. He knew each of the residents of the island by name. When [[Phee Genoa]] introduced him to [[Hunter]], [[Wrecker]], [[Tech]], and [[Omega]], he warmly shook each of their hands in greeting. He was a hospitable host, welcoming [[Clone Force 99]] to his home in [[Lower Pabu]] for a feast that Genoa characterized as "famous." When a [[Tsunami]] occurred, Hazard was quick to help evacuate the residents of Lower Pabu and checked to make sure everyone made it to [[Upper Pabu]] safely. In the aftermath of the surge, he lamented the destruction, but only truly cared about the safety of his people. {{Char-stub}} ==Appearances== *{{TBB|Pabu (episode)}} {{1st}} *{{TBB|Tipping Point}} *{{TBB|The Return}} {{Mo}} *{{TBB|Point of No Return (The Bad Batch)}} *{{TBB|The Cavalry Has Arrived}} ==Sources== *{{InsiderCite|228|Star Wars: The Bad Batch Season Three Companion|''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season Three Companion}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Databank|shep-hazard|Shep Hazard}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Shep Hazard |es=Shep Hazard |fr=Shep Hazard |ja=シェップ・ハザード |ka=შეპ ჰაზარდი |nl=Shep Hazard }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Hazard, Shep}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Mayors]]
